text:
DUCKS ON THE POND CARDS FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS

Version: November 2026 (test harness release)

Related documents: User's Guide (users-guide.txt), Capabilities Summary (capabilities-summary.txt), Customer Service Policy (customer-service-policy.txt).

DUCKS ON THE POND CARDS FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS › GETTING STARTED

Q: What is Ducks on the Pond Cards? A: A web application for sports card collectors. You can record the cards you own, keep a wishlist, find collectors who have the cards you want, trade with them, and see reports on your inventory, sales and profit.

DUCKS ON THE POND CARDS FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS › GETTING STARTED

Q: Does it cost anything? A: No. The application is currently free.

DUCKS ON THE POND CARDS FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS › GETTING STARTED

Q: How do I sign in? A: There are no personal accounts yet. Use the "Test user" drop-down at the top of any page, choose Alice, Bob or Carol, and click "Switch".

DUCKS ON THE POND CARDS FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS › GETTING STARTED

Q: Which test user should I pick? A: Alice and Bob are collectors. Carol is an admin and is the only one who can use the Admin page. To try a trade, act as one collector, then switch to the other to respond.

DUCKS ON THE POND CARDS FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS › GETTING STARTED

Q: Why does the page say "Test login is off in this environment"? A: Test sign-in has been turned off where you are, usually in production. You can browse the catalog but cannot add or change anything.

DUCKS ON THE POND CARDS FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS › GETTING STARTED

Q: Why does a page say "Pick a test user first"? A: My collection, Wishlist, Trades and Reports belong to a particular collector. Choose a test user at the top of the page and try again.

DUCKS ON THE POND CARDS FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS › GETTING STARTED

Q: Is there a mobile app? A: Not yet. The web application works in a phone's browser.

DUCKS ON THE POND CARDS FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS › THE CATALOG

Q: What is the difference between a set, a parallel, a card and a variant? A: A set is a product release, such as 2024 Topps Chrome. A parallel is a version of the set's cards, such as Base or Gold Refractor /50. A card is one numbered card in the set, such as #150 Shohei Ohtani. A variant is a specific card in a specific parallel, optionally with an autograph or relic. You add variants to your collection.

DUCKS ON THE POND CARDS FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS › THE CATALOG

Q: The card I own is not in the catalog. What do I do? A: Add it. Go to Catalog, open or add the set, add the parallel if it is missing, add the card, then add the variant. Anyone signed in can add to the catalog.

DUCKS ON THE POND CARDS FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS › THE CATALOG

Q: Why does every set already have a Base parallel? A: The application creates a Base parallel for every new set, and a Base variant for every new card, so you can add base cards straight away.

DUCKS ON THE POND CARDS FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS › THE CATALOG

Q: I made a mistake in the catalog. Can I edit or delete it? A: Not from the interface yet. Contact support with the set, card number and what is wrong. Catalog changes affect every collector, so support confirms corrections before making them.

DUCKS ON THE POND CARDS FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS › THE CATALOG

Q: Why did I get "That already exists"? A: A set, parallel, card or variant with the same details is already in the catalog. Look for it in the list instead of adding it again.

DUCKS ON THE POND CARDS FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS › MY COLLECTION

Q: How do I add a card I own? A: Go to My collection, choose the variant under "Add a card to my collection", fill in any details you have (serial number, grade, cert number, price paid, date acquired, condition) and click "Add card".

DUCKS ON THE POND CARDS FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS › MY COLLECTION

Q: Which grading companies are supported? A: PSA, BGS, SGC and CGC. Grades go from 1 to 10 in half steps. Choose "Raw (ungraded)" for an ungraded card.

DUCKS ON THE POND CARDS FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS › MY COLLECTION

Q: Why do I get "Enter both a grading company and a grade, or neither"? A: A graded card needs both its company and its grade. For a raw card, leave both blank.

DUCKS ON THE POND CARDS FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS › MY COLLECTION

Q: Can I edit a card after adding it? A: You can change its Tradeable setting and its listed price, mark it sold, or undo a sale. The grade, serial number, cert number and price paid cannot be edited yet. Delete the card and add it again with the right details.

DUCKS ON THE POND CARDS FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS › MY COLLECTION

Q: What is the difference between Delete and Mark sold? A: Delete removes the card permanently. Mark sold keeps it as a sale record, so it shows in your Sold report with its profit. Use Mark sold if you sold the card.

DUCKS ON THE POND CARDS FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS › MY COLLECTION

Q: I marked a card sold by mistake. Can I undo it? A: Yes. Click "Undo sale" in the Sold table. The card returns to your collection. It comes back not tradeable, so turn Tradeable on again if you want to offer it.

DUCKS ON THE POND CARDS FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS › MY COLLECTION

Q: Can I upload photos of my cards? A: Not yet. Photo upload is planned but not built.

DUCKS ON THE POND CARDS FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS › SERIAL NUMBERS

Q: What is a serial number? A: The number stamped on a numbered card, for example 23 on a card numbered 23/50. Enter just the 23.

DUCKS ON THE POND CARDS FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS › SERIAL NUMBERS

Q: Why was my card "sent to an admin for review"? A: Another collector already holds an unsold copy of the same variant with that serial number. Only one copy of each serial can exist, so an admin checks which entry is correct.

DUCKS ON THE POND CARDS FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS › SERIAL NUMBERS

Q: How long does a serial-number review take? A: The aim is 5 business days. Check the status under "My serial-number reviews" on the My collection page, as review emails are not set up yet.

DUCKS ON THE POND CARDS FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS › SERIAL NUMBERS

Q: What happens during a review? A: The admin compares both entries and may ask either collector for a photo of the card's front and back. If one entry is a typo, it is corrected and the valid one approved. The admin's note explains the decision.

DUCKS ON THE POND CARDS FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS › SERIAL NUMBERS

Q: What if I disagree with the decision? A: Ask for a second review. See section 11 of the Customer Service Policy.

DUCKS ON THE POND CARDS FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS › SERIAL NUMBERS

Q: Why do I get "Serial N is higher than the print run"? A: The serial you entered is larger than the number made, for example 51 on a /50 card. Check the number, and check you chose the right variant.

DUCKS ON THE POND CARDS FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS › WISHLIST

Q: What is the difference between "Any version of a card" and "An exact variant"? A: "Any version" matches every parallel and variant of that card. "An exact variant" matches only that one, for example only the Gold Refractor /50.

DUCKS ON THE POND CARDS FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS › WISHLIST

Q: Can other collectors see my wishlist? A: Only wants marked Public. Public is ticked by default. Untick it to keep a want private.

DUCKS ON THE POND CARDS FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS › WISHLIST

Q: Why are no matches showing? A: Matches only include other collectors' cards that are marked tradeable and meet your minimum grade and grading company, if you set them. Try loosening the minimum grade, or check back later.

DUCKS ON THE POND CARDS FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS › WISHLIST

Q: Does the max price filter matches? A: No. It is saved with your want for reference, but matching uses the card and grade only.

DUCKS ON THE POND CARDS FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS › TRADING

Q: How do I start a trade? A: Go to Trades, choose a collector under "Trade with", click "Show their tradeable cards", tick the cards you will give and the cards you want, and click "Propose trade". Or click "propose a trade" next to a match on your Wishlist page.

DUCKS ON THE POND CARDS FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS › TRADING

Q: Why can't I see my card in the "I give" list? A: Only tradeable cards are listed. Turn on Tradeable for the card in My collection.

DUCKS ON THE POND CARDS FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS › TRADING

Q: Can a trade be one-sided? A: Yes. You can only give or only ask, as long as at least one card is chosen.

DUCKS ON THE POND CARDS FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS › TRADING

Q: How do I make a counteroffer? A: On a trade offered to you, click "Counter...". The same cards are preselected; change them, add a message, and click "Send counteroffer". The original offer is marked "countered".

DUCKS ON THE POND CARDS FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS › TRADING

Q: Who can complete a trade? A: Either collector, once the trade is accepted. Only click "Complete (cards exchanged)" after you have actually received the cards.

DUCKS ON THE POND CARDS FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS › TRADING

Q: What happens when a trade is completed? A: The cards move to their new owners in one step. Each card arrives not tradeable, with today's date as its acquired date, and without the previous owner's paid or listed price.

DUCKS ON THE POND CARDS FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS › TRADING

Q: Why was my trade cancelled when nobody cancelled it? A: A card in it was turned off as tradeable, sold, or traded in another deal. The application cancels offers that include those cards.

DUCKS ON THE POND CARDS FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS › TRADING

Q: Why do I get "A card in this trade has changed owner or been sold"? A: The same card was in another offer that was completed first, or its owner sold it. Propose a new trade with the cards that are still available.

DUCKS ON THE POND CARDS FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS › TRADING

Q: How do the physical cards get delivered? A: The two collectors arrange it between themselves. The application does not handle shipping or payment.

DUCKS ON THE POND CARDS FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS › TRADING

Q: What if the other collector never sends the card? A: Do not click Complete until you have received it. If a completed trade goes wrong, contact the other collector first, then support. See section 6.4 of the Customer Service Policy.

DUCKS ON THE POND CARDS FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS › SELLING AND PRICES

Q: Can I sell cards through the application? A: You can list an asking price and record sales, but no payments go through the application. You arrange the sale yourself and then record it with "Mark sold".

DUCKS ON THE POND CARDS FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS › SELLING AND PRICES

Q: Why is the Market column in my reports blank? A: Market prices can be shown, but there is no screen to enter them yet, so most cards have none.

DUCKS ON THE POND CARDS FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS › SELLING AND PRICES

Q: How is profit calculated? A: Sold price minus the price you paid. If you did not enter a paid price, profit is left blank for that card.

DUCKS ON THE POND CARDS FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS › SELLING AND PRICES

Q: What is Margin in the For sale report? A: Your listed price minus the price you paid.

DUCKS ON THE POND CARDS FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS › REPORTS

Q: What reports are there? A: A summary, an inventory report, a for-sale report and a sold report. See section 9 of the User's Guide.

DUCKS ON THE POND CARDS FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS › REPORTS

Q: Do my reports include other collectors' cards? A: No. Reports only show your own cards.

DUCKS ON THE POND CARDS FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS › SEARCH

Q: What does the Search page search? A: The Ducks on the Pond Cards help documents: the User's Guide, this FAQ, the Collector Handbook, Glossary, policies and release notes. It does not search cards or collections.

DUCKS ON THE POND CARDS FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS › SEARCH

Q: Why does it say "Not in the documents"? A: No passage was similar enough to your question. Try rewording it. The page shows the best score it found so you can see how close it came.

DUCKS ON THE POND CARDS FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS › SEARCH

Q: Is there a length limit on questions? A: Yes, 500 characters.

DUCKS ON THE POND CARDS FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS › PRIVACY

Q: What can other collectors see about me? A: Your username, your tradeable cards (including grade, serial and cert number) and your public wants. The application does not show them your prices, acquired dates, private wants, non-tradeable cards or sales.

DUCKS ON THE POND CARDS FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS › PRIVACY

Q: Who can see my trades? A: Only you and the other collector in the trade. Admins cannot see trades they are not part of.

DUCKS ON THE POND CARDS FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS › PRIVACY

Q: Who can read the message I send with a trade offer? A: Only you and the other collector in that trade can see the trade and its message. Keep payment and address details out of trade messages and wishlist notes (Collector Handbook section 7).

DUCKS ON THE POND CARDS FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS › PRIVACY

Q: Can admins see my collection? A: Yes. Admins can see all collection data and use it only to resolve serial-number conflicts and support requests.

DUCKS ON THE POND CARDS FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS › PRIVACY

Q: Can I delete my data? A: Yes. Contact support. See section 10 of the Customer Service Policy.

DUCKS ON THE POND CARDS FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS › HELP AND SUPPORT

Q: How do I contact support? A: See section 4 of the Customer Service Policy for contact details and what to include in your request.

DUCKS ON THE POND CARDS FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS › HELP AND SUPPORT

Q: What does "Something went wrong. It has been logged as action_failed" mean? A: An unexpected error happened and was recorded. Try again. If it keeps happening, contact support and say when it happened.

DUCKS ON THE POND CARDS FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS › HELP AND SUPPORT

Q: Will I get an email when someone offers me a trade? A: Not yet. Email and push notifications are not built. Check your Trades page.

DUCKS ON THE POND CARDS FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS › HELP AND SUPPORT

Q: Is my test data permanent? A: No. Data in a test environment may be reset without notice.
